steps.assistant_text: Boundary merge + opt-level fix. The 99% 'branch-into-adjacent-return-0-leaf cap' was an -O0 frameless predicate mis-split at every jr ra: the 'return-0 leaf' next symbol is the function's own else arm and the following 2-word 'empty stub' is ugen's dead fall-off return. C: if (a0[2]==a0[1]) { return 1; } return 0; at -O0 (no uopt => no preset-default hoist of move v0,zero, so the two return arms stay separate blocks and the bne lands on the else arm at +4). Compare operands are written in ROM load order because IDO -O0 evaluates the RIGHT operand first. Our 7.1 -O0 emits two dead trailing jr-ra pairs where the shipped build has one, so the function is file-terminal and TRUNCATE_TEXT clips the extra pair (o0_11D78 precedent).
